items.distractor_fact: Meteorolog o sabah kendi termometresinde {D} derece okudu.
items.gloss_en: The meteorologist read {D} degrees on his own thermometer that morning.
items.entity_note: belongs to a person (the meteorologist's own thermometer), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's place (the neighboring town's station), and not the instrument whose morning/afternoon readings the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Aynı gün bir tahvil {D} dolardan işlem gördü.
items.gloss_en: On the same day, a bond traded at {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different financial instrument (a bond), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other company's stock, and not the stock whose opening/closing price the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Belediyenin nehir ölçüm istasyonundaki seviye aynı sabah {D} santimetreydi.
items.gloss_en: The level at the municipality's river measurement station was {D} centimeters that same morning.
items.entity_note: belongs to a municipal organization's river gauge, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's neighboring lake (a place), and not the lake whose morning/evening levels the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Komşu inşaat şirketinin vinç kolu o sırada {D} metre yükseklikteydi.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring construction company's crane arm was at {D} meters of altitude at that moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a construction company's crane, an organization-owned instrument, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other drone, and not the drone whose first/second measurements the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir nakliye firmasının gönderisi {D} kilogram geliyordu.
items.gloss_en: Another freight company's shipment weighed {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different freight company (an organization), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's sibling package in the same shipment, and not the package whose shipping/delivery weight the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Firmanın teslimat kamyonu o sırada {D} km/h hızla gidiyordu.
items.gloss_en: The company's delivery truck was going {D} km/h at that moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a company's delivery truck, an organization-owned instrument, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's anonymous vehicle in the next lane, and not the vehicle whose first/second speed measurements the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Şehir dışındaki bir şubede aynı gün {D} lira çekildi.
items.gloss_en: At an out-of-town branch, {D} lira was withdrawn that same day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a specific out-of-town bank branch (a place), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other account holder, and not the account whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Aynı sektörde çalışan bağımsız bir danışmanın bu ayki geliri {D} lira oldu.
items.gloss_en: An independent consultant working in the same sector had an income of {D} lira this month.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual consultant (a person), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's competing business (an organization), and not the business whose income/expenses the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Ligin gol kralı bu sezon {D} gol attı.
items.gloss_en: The league's top scorer scored {D} goals this season.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual player (a person), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other team (an organization), and not the team whose scored/conceded goals the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Bir yatırım fonunun bu yılki kazancı {D} lira oldu.
items.gloss_en: An investment fund's gain this year was {D} lira.
items.entity_note: belongs to an investment fund (an organization), a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other individual investor, and not the investor whose gain/loss the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir turnuvada yarışan bir takım bu turda toplam {D} vuruş yaptı.
items.gloss_en: A team competing in a different tournament made a total of {D} strokes this round.
items.entity_note: belongs to a team (an organization) in a different tournament with its own unstated par, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other individual golfer, and not the golfer whose strokes-vs-par the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Farklı bir işletmeye ait servis aracı aynı saatte {D} dakikada durağa ulaştı.
items.gloss_en: A shuttle belonging to a different company reached the stop in {D} minutes at the same time.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different transit company (an organization) with its own unstated schedule, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's bus on a different line (a series), and not the bus whose actual/scheduled time the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir şirketin ofisinin bulunduğu kat {D}'dir.
items.gloss_en: A different company's office is located on floor {D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a company's office (an organization) with its own unstated reference floor, a different kind of owner from the first sentence's other building's apartment (a place), and not the apartment whose level-vs-reference the question compares
